posts.title: Finding my Voice Again
posts.description: You might have noticed that it’s been quiet here. I know that at least two people noticed, as they contacted me to ask, “Are you OK?” (Thank you to those who reached out.) I am OK. posts.description: Welcome to Technology Short Take 196! You will find articles on VPNs, Linux local privilege escalation (LPE) vulnerabilities, browser quirks and workarounds, the death of Terraform (again), and so much more
